messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Semiconductor?

The passages do not provide a ranked list specifically for “Semiconductor,” but they do support these key signaling test capability areas for the 5G device value chain, which includes chip vendors: RF, Signaling, Application, OTA, Pre-conformance, Conformance approval, Carrier acceptance, Non-signaling RF, Signaling Protocol, and Service/repair testing [84].
| Capability area | Supported capabilities |
|---|---|
| Multi-technology signaling and network emulation | R&S CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement solution for device testing, covering LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [68]. |
| Cellular + WLAN signaling coverage | R&S CMX500 provides NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, NB-IoT/NB-NTN signaling, and WLAN signaling/TX measurements covering 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn, and 2x2 MIMO [68]. |
| RF measurements and receiver metrics | Supported measurement functions include fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [68]. |
| Basic signaling-test RF metrics | The signaling test solution lists basic RF measurements including Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER/BLER, and MIMO [3]. |
| Application-layer and IP testing | R&S CMX500 application testing includes internal IP services and IP connection to DUT applications such as DNS, IMS, FTP, HTTP, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, Max Throughput Wizard, and web server [5]. |
| Protocol, advanced signaling, and automation | CMsquares supports RF tests, functional tests, advanced signaling tests, and protocol tests, while CMsequencer supports graphical test scripting, XLAPI supports Python-based complex scripting, and SCPI supports standardized remote control [4]. |
| 3GPP RF pre-conformance | 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance testing is positioned as early R&D/design verification against 3GPP TS 38.521-1, with selected RF transmission/reception tests and streamlined procedures for meaningful pre-conformance results [89]. |
| Pre-conformance test groups | Supported RF pre-conformance groups include UE output power, power dynamics/tolerance, modulation quality including EVM, spectrum tests including occupied bandwidth and ACLR, and receiver/throughput tests including reference sensitivity and maximum input level [91]. |
| Wi-Fi 7 R&D signaling | Wi-Fi 7 R&D testing with CMX500 is described as signaling-mode testing under real-world conditions for RF TX/RX characteristics, including 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E test capabilities [15]. |
| Coexistence / desense | CMX500 Desense Testing is described as a WLAN + cellular one-box interference/desense use case that simultaneously handles WLAN, LTE, and NR tests under real connections to observe mutual interference or desense effects [40]. |
| OTA signaling | CMX500 OBT integrated with MVG WaveStudio enables 5G NR, RedCap, LTE, and WLAN OTA signaling tests, and the later source extends this to full WLAN signaling including Wi-Fi 7 / IEEE 802.11be [31]. |
| Voice, IMS, audio, and QoE testing | CMX500 application/audio options support IMS voice codecs for 4G/5G, POLQA perceived speech quality measurement, WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA, and end-to-end audio delay [5]. |
| NTN / satellite-related signaling discovery | The NTN signaling questionnaire covers RF, Protocol, and Application testing layers; NB-NTN, NR-NTN, Direct-to-Cell; service link bands; satellite orbit; payload type; mobility; handover/beam switching; throughput, battery lifetime, and latency metrics [25]. |

- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] 5G test configuration，包含 [[R&S CMX-PB70H]]、[[R&S CMX-B200A]]、[[R&S CMX-B300C]]、[[R&S CMX-B600B]]、[[R&S CMX-KA100]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KM600]]。
- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi test configuration，包含 WLAN signaling、WLAN TX measurement 與 WLAN ARB generator options，例如 [[R&S CMX-KS350B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS351B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS352B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS355B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS356B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS360B]]、[[R&S CMX-KM350]]、[[R&S CMX-KM351]]、[[R&S CMX-KM352]]、[[R&S CMX-KM360]]、[[R&S CMX-KW350]]、[[R&S CMX-KW351]]、[[R&S CMX-KW352]]。
- 來源指出如果 UAV 使用兩種以上通訊技術，通訊技術之間可能造成相互干擾；基於 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援多種通訊技術，可進行 De-sense validation。
- 來源對多技術整合驗證的配置原則是：software options 合併上述 5G 與 Wi‑Fi 表格，hardware 以滿足兩者中最大的 carrier aggregation 或 [[MIMO]] 作為配置。
- 來源末尾列出兩個待讀材料：本機 PDF `5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100.pdf`，以及 SharePoint 上 `Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`；正文未擷取。

- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。

來源將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 描述為 designed for extremely high data throughput，面向 tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。來源列出的 higher throughput key elements：

|---|---|
| channel bandwidth | increased channel bandwidth of 320 MHz |
| spatial streams | up to 16 spatial streams |
| modulation | 4096 QAM modulation |
| MLO | key feature；使 multiple RF chains 測試環境變重要 |

- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

NTN IoT device testing requirements › 使用限制
- 本頁不是 3GPP NTN standard、NB-NTN certification plan 或 R&S formal order configuration。

NTN IoT device testing requirements › fading and path loss
來源指出 satellite connectivity 除 terrestrial fading profiles 外還需要 new fading profiles，包括 atmospheric fading 與 terrestrial fading 的組合，以及 rain、cloud、sun storms causing electron flow 等 weather-specific effects emulation。Large distance 造成 high free space path loss，導致 UE side low SNR。來源列出：

- Minimum SINR ≥ -10 dB。
- Minimum RSRP ≥ -137 dBm。
- NTN 第一階段目標為 outdoor connections。

來源未提供 3GPP clause、test condition 或 scenario profile，因此只作為測試需求線索。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

NTN IoT device testing requirements › unresolved
- [[R&S CMW-KP030]]、[[R&S CMW-KR317]]、[[R&S CMW-KU317]]、[[R&S CMW-KK307]] 的正式 availability 與 order number 未確認。
- TTCN expected CW24 / CW25 與 CMW-KK307 launch earliest Q3 or Q4 的年份脈絡需回原投影片。
- NB-NTN customer demo 中 Bullit Cat S75 spelling / model 是否為 [[Bullitt Cat S75]] 需確認。
- NTN topology 圖未提供 transparent / regenerative payload 的具體測試配置。

R&S NTN signaling solutions › 需求蒐集範圍
來源中的問題涵蓋：

- Service offerings：客戶預計透過 NTN 提供 [[IoT]]、broadband、voice 或其他 applications。
- Test environment：live network environment（包含 satellite gateway）或 simulated environment。
- Deployment timeline：NTN service deployment timeline、key milestones、deadlines。
- Test layer：RF、Protocol、Application Testing。
- Technology：[[NB-NTN]]、[[NR-NTN]]、[[Direct-to-Cell]] / [[DTC]] / [[D2C]]。
- 3GPP release：[[3GPP Rel. 17]]、[[3GPP Rel. 18]]、[[3GPP Rel. 19]] 及其 timeline。
- Device platform：NTN devices 使用的 chipset 或 hardware platform。
- Service link bands：S/L/Ku/Ka-Band。
- Gateway integration：是否把 CMX 連接到 [[satellite gateway]]，在 real live satellite network 測試；若是，需提供 gateway bands。
- Satellite orbit：[[LEO]]、[[MEO]]、[[GEO]]、[[GSO]]。
- Payload type：[[transparent satellite payload]] 或 [[regenerative satellite payload]]。
- DTC operator：LTE-DTC 與 NR-DTC 需要的 satellite operator。
- Network complexity：cellular cells 與 satellite cells 的組合。
- Long-term tests：是否需要 hundreds of satellites，例如 [[LEO]] scenario。
- UE：specific device model 或 generic UE simulator。
- Performance metrics：throughput、battery lifetime、latency 等。
- QoS：不同 traffic type 的 prioritization 或 guaranteed bandwidth。
- Mobility：stationary、pedestrian、vehicular 或其他 UE mobility pattern。
- Handover / beam switching：satellite-UE handovers、beam switching、seamless handovers、optimized beam switching。
- Constellation workflow：是否有興趣 configuring and visualizing constellations，並在 [[R&S CMX500]] environment 中部署其中一部分。

R&S NTN signaling solutions › 與 R&S CMX500 的關係
[[cmx500_ntn_customer_questionnaire]] 的檔名含 `cmx500`，正文也提到「CMX500 environment」。但來源未列 [[R&S CMX500]] 的硬體規格、option code、NTN feature matrix 或 ordering information。

因此：

- 可說：此問卷與 [[R&S CMX500]] / CMX environment 的 NTN signaling use case discovery 有關。
- 不可說：此問卷證明某個 [[R&S CMX500]] option 已支援某 release、band、orbit、satellite gateway interface、payload type 或 constellation scale。
- 正式規格仍需引用 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]、[[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 或其他正式 product / feature 文件。

[[R&S NTN signaling solutions]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 在 [[cmx500_ntn_customer_questionnaire]] 中用來描述其 [[Non-Terrestrial Network]]（[[NTN]]）signaling 測試相關 solution offering 的名稱；目前此頁只由客戶需求問卷支撐，不能視為正式規格頁。

Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices › 實體
- [[R&S CMX500]] — one-box signaling tester / multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester；本來源強調 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality、multiple radio technologies support、embedded IP test capabilities 與 multiple RF chains 測試環境。

Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices › 重點摘要

- 來源以 [[Bluetest RTS65]] 為例，說明 [[Bluetest]] reverberation chambers 用於 wireless devices 的 over-the-air performance evaluation。
- 來源說明 reverberation chamber 與 anechoic test chamber 的差異：reverberation chamber 會在 chamber 內大量反射 RF signal，形成 Rayleigh faded multipath RF environment；此環境接近 real-world indoor and city conditions。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] 被描述為 complex wireless solutions 的 integrated test environment。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，具 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality、multiple radio technologies support 與 embedded IP test capabilities。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 的 key components 被列為 320 MHz channel bandwidth、up to 16 spatial streams、4096 QAM modulation 與 [[MLO]]。
- 來源指出 [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature；因此測試環境提供 multiple RF chains 很關鍵。
- Rohde & Schwarz 引言人物為 [[Christoph Pointner]]，職稱 Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers at Rohde & Schwarz。
- Bluetest 引言人物為 [[Kjell Olovsson]]，職稱 Bluetest CEO。
- Press & media contact 為 [[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement，email 為 press@rohde-schwarz.com。
- Rohde & Schwarz 公司資訊：2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue EUR 3.16 billion；2025-06-30 員工超過 15,000 人。
- Bluetest 公司資訊：[[Bluetest AB]] based in Gothenburg, Sweden；來源稱其為 wireless equipment and small antenna OTA testing using Reverberation Test System 的 pioneer and market leader。

- EN-DC + WiFi7 is also possible。
- LTE + NR + WiFi Measurements in parallel。
- WiFi example slide 出現 4096QAM 與 320 MHz BW in 6GHz Band。

這些 desense / parallel measurement 內容更完整整理於 [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。

EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap › 重點摘要
- [[EMITE]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 繼續合作，enhance [[EMITE]] 的 [[OTA testing]] measurement solutions。
- 合作內容是 fully integrating the latest test capabilities of [[R&S CMX500]] multi-technology、multi-channel one-box signaling tester。
- 來源稱整合後除了支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]] 與 [[NR FR2]]，也支援 full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] / [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 cellular technologies，包括 [[LTE]]、[[5G NR]] [[NR FR1]] frequency range up to 8 GHz、[[NR FR2]] millimeter wave frequency range up to 50 GHz，以及 latest [[5G RedCap]] technology。
- 同一來源也說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 non-cellular technologies，包括 latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，all in a single instrument。
- 對 [[EMITE]] customers 的價值是取得 comprehensive environment，用於 accurately assessing the performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]] devices。
- 下一步合作方向是 integrating test capabilities for [[NB-IoT NTN]] 與 [[NR NTN]]；來源稱這些能力 already covered by [[R&S CMW500]] and [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 來源用背景段落說明 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 具 tens of gigabits per second、low latency，面向 ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality。
- 來源定義 [[RedCap]] 為 [[3GPP Release 17]] 的 5G technology，是 reduced-functionality version of 5G，相較 [[5G eMBB]] 成本顯著較低，具 mid-range data throughput、low power consumption、low complexity 與支援大量 devices 的能力，特別適合 [[IoT]] applications。
- [[David A. Sánchez-Hernández]] 以 [[EMITE]] CEO 身分表示，EMITE 將 testing chambers 升級到搭配 [[R&S CMX500]]，使 customers 可 extend capabilities to include [[IEEE 802.11be]] standard 與 Red Cap devices。
- [[Christoph Pointner]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers 身分表示，將 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 整合進 [[EMITE]] OTA chambers portfolio，可支援 latest technologies 的 reliability 與 efficiency 測試。
